stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class). Nicholls' Common Data Set page (nicholls.edu/irep/common-data-set/) only lists Common Data Set files through 2018-19, too old to use. Counts from the IPEDS file (via the Urban Institute API mirror): 3,369 applicants, 3,059 admitted, 1,082 enrolled (1,075 full-time + 7 part-time). College Navigator shows 3% submitting SAT (34 students) and 82% submitting ACT (884 students); SAT percentiles rest on a small group. International applicant counts, GPA and class rank are not published.
